dashboard.title: Extraction Pipeline - Hybrid (Geometric + LLaVA)
dashboard.description: Week 2-3: Monitor hybrid extraction pipeline performance, hallucination rate, latency, and manual review queue

targets.query: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN hybrid_method != 'manual_review' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) as success_rate FROM receipts WHERE date >= DATE('now', '-1 day')
SELECT hybrid_method as method, COUNT(*) as count FROM receipts WHERE date >= DATE('now', '-1 day') GROUP BY hybrid_method ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT AVG(hallucination_rate) as rate FROM extraction_metrics WHERE date >= DATE('now', '-7 days')
SELECT date, hybrid_method as method, AVG(extraction_latency_ms) as latency FROM receipts WHERE date >= DATE('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY date, hybrid_method ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) as pending FROM manual_review_queue WHERE completed_at IS NULL

SELECT extraction_risk_level, COUNT(*) as count FROM receipts WHERE date >= DATE('now', '-1 day') GROUP BY extraction_risk_level ORDER BY CASE extraction_risk_level WHEN 'low' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 END
SELECT COUNT(*) as pending FROM extraction_queue WHERE status = 'pending'
SELECT MAX(CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(created_at)) * 1440 AS INTEGER)) as oldest_minutes FROM manual_review_queue WHERE completed_at IS NULL
SELECT date, method, avg_accuracy FROM extraction_metrics WHERE date >= DATE('now', '-7 days') ORDER BY date ASC, method
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) as completion_rate FROM manual_review_queue WHERE created_at >= datetime('now', '-1 day')

alerts.title: Hallucination Rate > 3%
alerts.condition: SELECT AVG(hallucination_rate) FROM extraction_metrics WHERE date = DATE('now') > 3

alerts.title: P99 Latency > 2000ms
alerts.condition: SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extraction_latency_ms) FROM receipts WHERE date = DATE('now') > 2000

alerts.title: Manual Review Queue > 100
alerts.condition: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manual_review_queue WHERE completed_at IS NULL > 100

alerts.title: GPU Utilization > 80%
alerts.condition: SELECT gpu_utilization FROM system_metrics WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-5 minutes') > 80
